scenarios.title: Bootstrapping a git worktree
scenarios.diff:
git fetch origin main
git worktree add -b "$BRANCH" "../$REPO-worktrees/$SLUG" origin/main
cd "../$REPO-worktrees/$SLUG"
npm install
git config core.hooksPath .githooks

existing.name: Git worktrees
existing.description: A worktree is a second working directory attached to the same repository, so two branches can be checked out at once.

existing.name: Git hooks
